cyclone.target: Count of distinct MAIN SIDs with a North Indian basin tropical (NATURE=TS) record, assigned to their first such month. Includes tropical depressions; no wind threshold or landfall definition.
cyclone.zeros: Explicit zero eligible archived storm IDs in an included calendar month. Not verified absence of all cyclones/disasters.
cyclone.excluded: Pre-1980, 2025/2026 incomplete/provisional years, non-main tracks, non-NI positions, non-TS positions. First qualifying month determined before date filtering to avoid counting cross-year storms twice.
cyclone.geography: NI basin, not Indian political territory or district landfalls.
